purpose: Threaded socket server adapter that turns each TCP client connection into a Movie plus VT100Player session and writes rendered frame bytes to the socket.
invariants: ThreadedTCPServer.daemon_threads stays true so handler threads do not block process shutdown.
ThreadedTCPServer.allow_reuse_address stays true so quick restarts can rebind the same port.
TelnetRequestHandler.filename is class-level shared configuration set by ascii_telnet_server.run_tcp_server before connections are accepted.
draw_frame receives a file-like BytesIO already rewound by VT100Player and writes raw bytes to the socket.
Broken pipe and connection reset errors stop playback; unexpected OSError values still propagate.
gotchas: The module is Python 3-only now; there is no SocketServer fallback.
filename is shared across handler instances, so do not mutate it per connection.

key_functions.name: TelnetRequestHandler.handle
key_functions.summary: Loads the configured movie, wires VT100Player.draw_frame to the request handler, and plays until completion or stop.

key_functions.name: TelnetRequestHandler.draw_frame
key_functions.summary: Writes the prepared frame buffer to the client socket and stops playback on expected disconnect errors.
